response.text: `tpl_fastapi_service` is a Python HTTP service skeleton designed for developers seeking a lightweight starting point for web applications. It provides a health check route alongside a basic in-memory CRUD resource to demonstrate core service logic and API endpoints. Verified by an included test file, the repository delivers a clean project structure to help kickstart custom service development.
